subject: general
question: Which of the following is a popular harvest dance in the Bundelkhand region of Madhya Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawara**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harvest dance **is another name for the **Jawara dance, **which is mostly performed in **Madhya Pradesh's Bundelkhand region.**
 
• This dance is performed by both sexes to commemorate their joy and prosperity following the harvest of their **Jowar crop.**
 
• While dancing, women balance the Jawara-filled baskets on their heads.
 
• The female dancers illustrate the importance of agriculture in our lives by carrying a large basket of Jawara crops on their heads.
 
• Both before and after the dancing performance, this action is performed.
 
• Dancers balance a basket on their heads while swaying while maintaining rigidity in their bodies.
 
• A lot of stunts and prop balancing are necessary for **Jawara dancing. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Popular in the adjacent nations of Nepal, Darjeeling, Assam, Bhutan, and Myanmar is** the Maruni dance.**
 
• **Himachal Pradesh's Charba **is a well-known folk dance that is performed during the Dussehra holiday.
 
• A popular ritualistic folk dance from Goa, India, is called** Dhalo**.
 
• Women conduct the dance as a type of protection prayer for their households.
